contract.text: check-pick-entered treats only a committed pick (decision.json scoreable, else pick_was_delivered) as something to verify; a preview, deferred or skip-day pick file is 'nothing to check': exit 0, no 'not entered' DM.
contract.trigger: an undelivered pick file (no decision record) / a skip-day decision record, 40 min before first pitch
contract.symptom_kind: extra event ('NOT entered ... Fix it now!' DM for an uncommitted pick)

level_justification: the tests replace the auth internals (load_session_cookies, extract_uid, fetch_login_session) besides the external contest fetches, the crosswalk fetch and the DM transport
notes: Revision 2 (2026-10-03, after the run at f453283): narrowed to the uncommitted-pick node. In revision 1 the skip-day node (test_skip_day_decision_no_dm) failed under the mutant by the same not-entered DM, but the observer refused to classify that call: the boundary's code was shared by 2 live functions (the first test's fake send_dm closure was still alive), which the recorder treats as unidentified, fail-closed. The skip-day case of the contract stays uncertified under that observer limit; the guard both cases pass through is defended by node 1.
